Commentary.Commentary: England bowled well and overall it was a collective effort on their part. Though they could have done well to restrict the damage, considering that they removed two set batsmen (Finch and Marsh) quickly. Mark Wood and Moeen Ali were the best among all. Adil Rashid picked up two wickets but was a bit expensive. Chris Woakes and Liam Plunkett were good in parts and failed to keep the pressure on the hosts. Right then, is 304 enough? Well, England do have the firepower in their ranks to gun this down. But they would very well know that the Aussie quicks would come out hard at them. Who will go 1-0 up? Join us back for the run chase in a short while...

Mitchell Marsh, too, departed as soon as he reached his fifty and it seemed like England are crawling their way back in this game. But it wasn't meant to be. Marcus Stoinis then stood up for his side and blazed through to a cracking 60 off just 40 balls to make sure his side ends on a high. Tim Paine did well to rotate strike and together they added quick 80 runs off just 59 balls with the former being the dominating one.

A competitive total on the board for Australia! They were put into bat and lost David Warner very early in the innings. Steven Smith did get a start but was removed before he could get his eye in. However, it was Aaron Finch who blasted away at the top. He stroked a boundary on the very first ball of the match and continued to motor along. He smashed his way to a rollicking ton and found an able partner in Mitchell Marsh who continued from where he left off in the Ashes. The duo accounted for a steady 118-run stand before the centurion threw it away.

FOUR! A boundary to end the innings! Australia should thank Jonny Bairstow here! Really sloppy! Back of a length delivery on middle and angling in, Tye swings across the line. Bairstow in the deep goes for the catch as he comes sprinting in. However, the ball bounces in front of him and he doesn't have his body behind the line. Concedes a boundary as AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 304/8!
Andrew Tye is the new man in.

OUT! Second wicket in the over! This is turning out to be an amazing last over from Plunkett! Good length ball on middle and leg, Cummins lofts it down the ground but doesn't get enough behind it. Jason Roy at long on comes a couple of steps in to take a safe catch.

FOUR! How unfortunate is Plunkett? He has bowled so well but this won't please him at all! Shortish in length on middle and leg, Pat Cummins wildly swings across the line but gets a fat top edge which sails over the keeper for a streaky boundary. 300 up for Australia!
Hits the deck hard, gets the extra bounce to beat the attempted pull shot of Cummins. Good over so far!
Mitchell Starc walks out to bat next.

OUT! Good take in the deep by Moeen Ali! Short of a length delivery, this time Paine hits it well. Seemed like it would travel over the fence but Ali at deep square leg swiftly moves to his right and remains cool to take it near the ropes.
Shortish in length and outside off, Tim Paine looks to pull but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Fuller in length and angling in, flicked towards deep square leg and comes back for a brace.

In the air... safe again! Short and climbing off the deck, Tim Paine looks to pull but gets a top edge. It flies towards Rashid at fine leg who charges in but the ball lands short. They take a single.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.

That must have hurt! Back of a length delivery, at 141.4 kph, Paine tries to hoick it across the line but misses to get hit on the box. The ball rolls away and he manages to scamper through to the other end. A leg bye taken.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
He had a packed leg side field so what does Pat do? He makes room and mistimes his loft over extra cover. Had enough to clear the infield as they take a couple.
Mark Wood is back on!
Tim Paine shuffles across to play the reverse scoop but fails to get any wood on it. He thinks it might be called as a wide but the umpire doesn't.
On a length and outside off, punched through cover for another single. Good bowling from Chris!
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Rocks back and pulls this short ball in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Pat looks to tap and run but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards the off side for a single. Pat is off the mark.
Pat Cummins walks in next.

OUT! Mistimed hit and Root takes it! He claims the catch and it's good to see the batsman trusting him. Marcus Stoinis walks back after a breezy knock! Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Stoinis makes room to hit it down the ground. Gets it off the high portion of the bat and the ball almost dips in front of Root who does well to dive forward at mid off and takes it inches above the ground. First wicket for Woakes!
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
SIX! Nailed it! Back of the hand delivery on the stumps, Stoinis clears his front leg and smokes it down the ground for a clean biggie.
Wide! Slower one down the leg side, Marcus looks to swipe it down the leg side but misses.
FOUR! Easy peasy for Stoinis! That brings up his fifty too, 2nd in this format! Full toss, veering on the pads. Flicked with disdain through backward square leg. No need to run!
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. They pick up a single.
Eases the full ball down the ground for a single.

In the air... well short of Bairstow! Plunkett keeps it nice and full outside off, Marcus makes room to go inside out but the bat turns in his hands. He slices it over extra cover but it lands safely before Jonny mops it up. Two taken.
Shortish on middle, a mistimed pull towards square leg for just a single.
Fuller in length outside off, driven hard but finds Morgan at cover. Just a single.
Length delivery outside off, slapped powerfully square of the wicket on the off side for a brace.

FOUR! Beats the man at mid off! Fuller in length and outside off, Stoinis drills it down the ground. He hopes that the mid off fielder doesn't cut it and he can't get to it. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
Fuller in length and angling in, wristed through mid-wicket for a single.
Chris Woakes is back on! He has been expensive today, giving 53 runs in his 8 overs so far.
On a length and outside off, punched towards cover for a single.
Slower delivery, takes eternity to arrive. It's at 98kph, Tim waits, waits and then hits it over point for just a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! That has come off the meat and in the gap too! Shortish ball on middle, Paine swivels and pulls it over square leg. There is a man at fine leg but he can't get to it. Back-to-back boundaries for the Aussie keeper. Brings up the 50-run stand between the two.

FOUR! Good batting this! Paine sees that mid on is inside the circle so what does he do? Picks up the slower ball from Liam and pulls it cleanly over mid on. The fielder gives it a chase but to no avail.
Shortish and angling in on the body, Paine helps his pull through backward square leg for a couple. Good running! 250 comes up for Australia!
Very full on the stumps, swinging back in a touch, worked through mid-wicket and picks up a couple does Stoinis.
Uses the pace and runs it down towards third man for a single.
Stays rooted inside the crease and flat bats it through mid-wicket for one.
Stands back and dabs it towards the off side.
Looks to hit it across the line but gets a thick inside edge on the pads. MS looks frustrated!

FOUR! Has that gone all the way? Shortish outside off, too much room for Stoinis to work with. He rises on the toes and flays it over point. There is a man in the deep but the ball is wide from him. The umpire confirms with the fielder whether it has gone all the way or not. Replays show it bounced before going into the rope.
Punches it off the back foot through covers for a single.
Fine leg is up.
FOUR! No one in the deep! Shortish in length on middle, Marcus pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
It was there to be hit! Slower ball, fuller in length outside off, Stoinis clears his front leg to hit it down the ground but is undone due to the lack of pace on it.

Was that a drop? Yes, it was! Fuller in length and outside off, Tim Paine drives it uppishly back to the bowler who dives forward in his followthrough and sticks out his left hand but the ball goes off his fingers to mid off and they take a single.
Fractionally short and outside off, Marcus goes back to pull but then at the last moment he decides to punch it towards mid on for a single.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Stoinis carves it over backward point for a brace.
Liam Plunkett is back into the attack.
FOUR! Sublime! In the zone outside off, Paine leans ahead and caresses it through covers for a glorious boundary.
Wood certainly hits the deck hard! Back of a length outside off, seaming in substantially and also taking off after pitching. Paine flashes at it but misses.
Full length ball around off, Paine strokes it to Wood who does well to stop it in his followthrough.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, driven sweetly but finds the man in the cover region.
On a length, some extra bounce on this occasion, Stoinis hops and tucks it to square leg to rotate strike. Moves to 22 from 19 balls.
Short of a length outside off, Tim steers it behind point to rotate strike.
Mark Wood is back on.
Hangs back to the good length ball and blocks it nicely.

Good calling from Paine! He is really alert. Back of a length outside off, tapped with an open bat face towards point and Stoinis looks for the run. Roy charges in and seeing that, Paine sends his partner back. These fine things matter a lot in cricket.
Short delivery, sits up nicely for Paine. Pulled with the angle to the leg side for a run.
In the air... but safe! Fullish delivery well outside off, encouraging Stoinis to go for an ambitious stroke. He obliges but gets it off the outer half past the backward point fielder. A run taken.
Back of a length outside off, Paine waits for it and plays it with an angled bat past point. A run taken.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, worked around the corner for a run.
Slow through the air, Paine lunges forward in defense.
Played with the spin past cover-point for a single.

SIX! Bang goes Stoinis! Hit with command. He is nimble on his feet and takes it on the full. Bludgeons it over wide long on and the ball just clears the ropes. Mind you, these are big boundaries and it takes a lot of power to clear them.
Strides forward to the tossed up ball and eases it through covers to pick up a single.
Paine is failing to read Rashid! Wrong 'un around off, Paine plays for the away spin but gets an inside edge down the track.
Fullish and down the leg side, swept all along the carpet to fine leg for a single.
Woakes bowls another incoming length delivery around off, tapped with an open bat face to point.
Makes good use of the depth of the crease to play it with an angled bat through point for a run.
Good running! On a length, straight this time, tucked neatly through backward square leg for a brace.
Good length ball, stump-to-stump line this time, defended solidly off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, steered nicely behind point to rotate strike.
On a length, shaping in, tucked around the corner for a run.
Chris Woakes returns for a burst.
Well bowled! The wrong one from Rashid. Tim fails to read it and gets an inside edge onto his pads. A tidy over from Rashid.
Floated on middle and leg, Stoinis strokes it down to long on for a run.
Leans ahead and caresses it through to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
Tim Paine strides out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Smart piece of bowling from Rashid brings in the breakthrough. He bowls a quicker one on middle and leg, Marsh fails to read it as he plays for the leg spin but misses to get his stumps rattled. Big wicket for England as Marsh can really flourish at the fag end of the innings. Good passage of play for the visitors.
Fullish on middle, tapped nicely to mid on.
Adil Rashid is back on.

10th ODI fifty for Mitchell Marsh! He has looked assured the moment he stepped in and has made his stay count. Was in good form in the Ashes series and has translated that into the limited-overs as well. On a length outside off, dabbed neatly to the point region for a single. Australia will hope that he carries on. He can be a really hard-hitter at the fag end of the innings.
Pitched right up there around off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Angling in appreciably, clipped with the angle through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Help myself kind of delivery and Stoinis obliges! Back of a length ball down the leg side, Marcus swivels across and helps his pull through fine leg to find the fence.
Shortish delivery, climbing on Stoinis. He does well to rise on his toes and blocks it out.
Wood goes really wide of the crease and angles in a length ball. Marsh pushes at it with hard hands but gets a thick inside edge towards mid-wicket. A run taken.
Leans ahead to the tossed up ball and smothers it on the turf. Brilliant spell from Moeen Ali. He finishes with figures of 10-0-39-1.
Fullish delivery, turning in, kept out watchfully.
Fullish delivery, Marsh taps it towards mid on and crosses through for a swift single.
Hangs deep in the crease and turns it towards the man at 45 to open his account with a single.
Time for Drinks. Meanwhile, Marcus Stoinis comes out to bat. This is his first ODI in Australia. Can he make it a memorable one?

OUT! Finch departs after a terrific knock! Gets a standing ovation as well. Fullish delivery around off, Finch clears his front leg and goes for the heave but ends up mistiming it. The ball swirls in the sky towards deep mid-wicket. Jonny Bairstow in the deep is safe as a house. He runs in, judges it nicely and pouches it with ease. Can the Englishmen capitalize upon it?
A shot of a tired man! Shorter in length, spinning in sharply. Finch makes a lot of room and tries to cut it away but gets beaten. The ball goes past the leg stump.
Sharp short ball, Mitchell sways away from the line to evade it.
Short ball, pulled all along the carpet to deep backward square leg for a run.

A polite inquiry for an LBW is not paid heed to! Wood goes very wide of the crease and angles in a length ball. Marsh tries to run it down but the ball hits his thigh pad and rolls behind point. The Englishmen bail out of the appeal soon as the batsmen take a leg bye.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Wood steams in and hits the deck hard. Marsh hops and answers it with a straight bat. Wood slips a bit in his followthrough but maintains his balance in the end.
Leg bye! Angling in substantially, Finch tries to clip it away but the ball brushes his pads and rolls to the leg side. A single taken.
Mark Wood returns for a burst.
Ali continues in the same way, kept out watchfully.
Flatter one, Marsh hangs back and punches it out.
Uses his feet to this one but decides to defend it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Hangs back to the flatter ball and keeps it out.
Floated delivery, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Bang! Floated in line of the stumps, bludgeoned over the bowler for a rocketing boundary. 13 from the over, Australia motoring along.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Clipped against the turn through the same region to rotate strike.
Spinning in, tucked through mid-wicket for a run.

SIX! Reaches his 9th ODI ton in style! What a power-packed performance from the pocket sized dynamite. Wrong 'un from Rashid. Finch picks it up and has a big heave at it. Doesn't get it off the meat of the bat but such is the power of the man that the ball clears the long on fence with ease. The opener is pumped up and gets a huge round of applause from the crowd. This is the third century for Finch against England in as many matches at the MCG.
Tossed up ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
Leans ahead and taps it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fullish ball, swept to the leg side.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total. That brings up the 100-run stand between the two. They have picked up pace and are looking ominous now.
Spinning in, tucked around the corner for a run.

An appeal for a caught behind turned down! Down the leg side, Finch kneels to go for a sweep but seems to have missed it. The ball goes off something to the keeper who takes it and appeals but the umpire stays unmoved. Replays show that it came off the pads.
Fullish ball, tapped to covers for a run.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side.
Hangs back to the shortish ball and keeps it out.

SIX! Flat as an arrow! That took off like a bow takes off from an archer. Tossed up on middle and off, Finch smacks it over long on for a maximum. The security guard was in the danger line but thankfully, he didn't get hit. Moves to 95 with that. 13 from the over already.
Fullish delivery, driven against the spin through mid on for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

SIX! Poor delivery and duly punished! This young man certainly packs a punch! Half tracker around off, Marsh rocks back and pulls it with aplomb over deep mid-wicket. It is going, going and sails over the fence.
Spinning in, Marsh clips it to long on for a single and will retain strike.
Similar delivery, driven through the same region again for another run.
Spinning into Mitchell who strides forward to work it past mid on and gets a single.
Hangs back and works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Spinning down the leg side, tucked past the diving short fine leg fielder for a couple.
Here he comes but doesn't go for it says an excited Bill Lawry on air! Tossed up ball, Marsh uses his feet but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Nudges it through mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy ball on off, Marsh takes a step forward and milks it down to long on for a single.
Slow through the air, defended solidly off the front foot.
Leans ahead nicely and tucks it to the leg side to rotate strike.
Shorter in length, ample time for Marsh to rock back and tap it through point for a single.
Finch clips this one against the spin through mid-wicket to pick up a run.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Tossed up ball on a fullish length, Finch crouches and sweeps it hard behind square on the leg side to pick up a boundary.
Rashid is back on. He was really good in his first spell. Good attacking captaincy from Morgan as well. A slip is in place.
Spinning in, pushed off the front foot to mid on.
Tossed up around off, Finch goes for a full-fledged sweep but doesn't get it off the meat off the bat. The ball flies towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting towards the batsman who tucks it to the leg side for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Leans ahead and drives it down with the spin through mid on for a single.
Well fielded! Shortish ball, punched crisply towards mid on where Roy dives to his left to make a good stop.
Full length ball outside off, Mitchell strokes it to covers for a single.
Waits for the slower one and dabs it towards third man for a run.

FOUR! That came off the pads but has been given as runs. Fuller in length, angling down. Finch tries to tickle it but misses. The ball brushes the pads and rolls past the keeper to reach the fence. With that, Finch goes past 3000 ODI runs, a good achievement for him.
Back of a length ball outside off, steered to third man to rotate strike.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Marsh pulls it towards fine leg to rotate strike.
Woakes is back on.
Sensible from Marsh! Hangs back and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Long off in place now and the man at 45 is up inside the ring.
Waits for this one and nudges it around the corner for a single.

Brilliant work by Morgan almost works for England! Flat and quick, punched towards covers where Morgan is really agile. Marsh sets off for the run but seeing the fielder attack, he goes back. Just about gets back in time as the throw returns to the bowler.
Works this one with the spin towards backward square leg.
Makes a lot of room to the flatter delivery and cuts it to covers.
Hangs back to the shortish ball and blocks it out.
Length ball, nudged to mid-wicket for a brisk run.
On a length outside off, played with an angled bat to point.

FOUR! Bludgeoned! Short ball on off, sits up nicely for Finch. He swivels across and nails the pull through mid-wicket for a rocketing boundary. Anything short and he is onto it in a flash. That brings up the 50-run stand between the duo, good going.
Well bowled and equally well played! Good length ball on middle, shoots off the deck. Marsh hops and rides the bounce nicely. Works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball on off, Finch drags his pull through backward square leg for a single.
On a length around off, shaping in. Tucked with a closed bat face to mid-wicket.
Chris Woakes returns for a bowl.
Flatter one on off, punched back towards the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

SIX! Clean as a whistle! A little flourish of the arms and that is a massive hit. Tossed up around off, Marsh clears his front leg and smokes it to send it sailing over the sightscreen. The ball rolls down slowly and the groundsman picks it up. When Marsh hits them, they stay hit.
Quicker one outside off, Mitchell dabs it nicely to covers.
Shorter in length, tucked off the hips towards backward square leg to rotate strike.
Floated on middle and leg, nudged towards the man at 45.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, tucked through backward square leg for a run.
Straighter this time, tucked easily through mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish ball, zipping after pitching. Marsh goes for a full-fledged pull but misses.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Hangs back to the good length ball and blocks it out.
Miscommunication but no harm done! Fullish and on leg stump, Finch misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads towards mid-wicket. Marsh is sent back a bit late but gets home safely.
Tossed up delivery, Marsh lunges forward in defense.

Dropped! Oh my word, chances are going down on a regular basis! Juicy full toss on middle, Finch hits it straight back to Ali. He puts his right hand out but the force on the ball is pretty much. Hits his hand and rolls towards long on. A single taken. Mind you, it was by no means an easy chance.
Spinning away from Marsh who taps it to point to rotate strike.
Tossed up ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
Fuller in length around off, Finch taps it to covers for a single.
Sits deep in the crease to the shortish ball and places it past the bowler for a run.
Nervy! Shuffles to the length ball and tries to tuck it but is early into the shot and as a result, chips it towards short mid-wicket. Another tight over, only 2 from it.
Angling in substantially, Aaron shuffles a touch and tucks it with a closed bat face to mid-wicket.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Wide! Plunkett loses  his radar and slips this one down the leg side. Finch fails to put bat to ball.

Dropped! A very tough chance though. Good length ball outside off, stops a bit on the pitch. Marsh is early into his drive and hence, mistimes it towards covers. Morgan leaps, gets his fingertips to it but the ball bursts through. A run taken.
On a length outside off, Marsh plays it with an angled bat to point.
Fractionally overpitched around off, Marsh punches it on the up to the man at mid off. He is looking solid out there.
Liam Plunkett is back on.
Nicely done. Makes room to the floated ball and creams it through to sweeper cover. The fielder moves to his right to cut it off. Two runs taken.
Spinning into Finch as he smothers ahead and dead bats it.
Slow and full delivery around off, Marsh leans ahead and strokes it down to long off for a single.
Ali pulls his length back again, punched off the back foot.
Marsh is nimble on his feet as he eases the loopy delivery to extra cover.
Shortish in length, punched off the back foot to covers.
Good shot but fails to find the gap. Drifting towards Finch who sweeps it hard but picks up the short fine leg fielder.
Slow through the air on off, milked down to long off to rotate strike.
Outside off, driven with the spin to the covers.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single.
Leans ahead to the tossed up delivery an blocks it.
SIX! Brute power! He didn't hit it from the meat of the bat but look at his audacity! Tossed up around off, Finch kneels and powers it over long on for a maximum. He is in the zone.

18th ODI fifty for Finch! He has looked confident from the word go and has played a breezy knock. Fullish on middle, clipped uppishly to deep mid-wicket for a run. Raises his bat towards the crowd and sinks in all the applause on offer.
Uses his feet to this one and knocks this one to long on for a single.
Nicely bowled! Straighter one outside off, Marsh plays for the turn and is beaten all ends up.
Fullish delivery, eased through mid-wicket for a single.
Well played! Short and room on offer, Finch rocks back and cuts it through point to pick up a couple.
Sits deep in the crease and turns this one to the leg side.
Spin from both ends. Moeen Ali comes into the attack.
Floated delivery, Marsh lunges forward in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish delivery, eased off the front foot to mid off.
Hangs back to this one and punches it through covers for a run.
FOUR! Hit with authority! Tossed up delivery, Finch kneels and brings out the big sweep. The square leg umpire is in the firing line as the ball goes past him in a flash and races to the fence.
Fullish around off, played with an open bat face towards point.
Drinks are on the field!
Fuller and angling in middle and leg, flicked through square leg to pick up a brace.
Length delivery outside off, tapped towards the point fielder.

FOUR! What was that? Shortish delivery, angling on middle and leg. Mitchell Marsh moves inside the line to make a leave but the ball keeps coming on him. It goes off something to the fine leg fence. Oh! In fact, replays show that it went of the gloves.
Leg bye! Angling in on middle and leg, Finch looks to flick but it goes off the pads towards fine leg.
Shortish on middle and leg, tucked towards short mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mitchell Marsh plays it with an angled bat towards point.
Loopy ball outside off, driven towards the cover fielder for nothing.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Full toss, dipping in, whipped towards mid on for a single.
Lunges forward and defends it into the ground.

NOT OUT! Missing leg! Goodness me! The ball has spun so much! Rashid doles out another googly, Finch gets across to flick but misses to wear it on the pads. They keep appealing but the pair is busy taking the leg bye. Rashid has a talk with Morgan and they take the DRS. Hawk Eye shows the impact is in the line but it would have spun too much to miss the leg stump. England lose their review!
After a long thought, England take a review for LBW against Aaron Finch. Looks really close...
Around middle and leg, worked towards short fine leg.
Mitchell Marsh is the new man in, replacing Travis Head. He was in good form in the Ashes. Let's see if he can continue in same vein here.

OUT! Head chops it on! Liam Plunkett strikes! He is all pumped up as well. He slants it away on a length and outside off, Head stays leg side of the ball and tries to hit it through the line but maybe, the slowness on the surface gets the better of him. Ekes out an inside edge which goes on the bounce to disturb the stumps behind. Australia are in a bit of bother now.
Wide!  The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Covers the line and defends it down safely.
Fuller ball on off, pushed towards mid off.
On a length and outside off, Head punches it off the back foot towards cover.
Good length delivery outside off, lofted over extra cover for a single.
On a length and outside off, Finch hangs his bat out but gets beaten all ends up.
FOUR! Lovely! Tossed up delivery outside off, Head takes a long stride forward and drives it through extra cover for a boundary to end the over.
Clips it away on the leg side for nothing.
Loopy delivery around middle and off, Finch gets down and slog sweeps it off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a single.
Takes a stride forward and bunts it back to the bowler.
Floated delivery around middle, nudged fine down the leg side for a brace.
Comes down the track and eases it down to long on for a single.
Stands back and deals with this back of a length delivery with a straight bat.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Edged and through! On a length and this one straightens a touch, Finch looks to drive but gets an outside edge which flies past the vacant slip cordon for a boundary towards third man. A streaky one.
FOUR! Pulled away! Sees the short ball, goes back and muscles the pull over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller ball on off, pushed towards cover.
Short and outside off, Finch stands tall and places it wide of backward point fielder for a brace.
Liam Plunkett is back into the attack.
Plays for the turn but this one skids through to beat the outside edge of Head's bat. 6 runs and a wicket off Rashid's first over.
Travis Head is the new man in.

OUT! Nicked and taken! Steven Smith is out of here! What a big, big wicket this. Adil Rashid comes into the attack and strikes immediately. He bowls the googly outside off, Smith stays back to force it through the line but this one turns back in, takes the inside edge and Buttler at first fumbles but then does well to gather it in the second. Smith didn't even wait for the umpire to raise his finger, he started to walk back. Just when Australia were getting a move on, England break the stand.
Wide! Slips one down the leg side, Smith leaves it alone.
Flattish delivery and skidding off the deck, Smith misses his tuck and wears it on the pads.
Floated delivery around middle and leg, Finch comes down the track and flicks it through square leg for a single.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
2 Wides! Floated delivery down the leg side, Finch gets down to sweep but misses and so does Buttler. The ball goes off the gloves towards short fine leg and they take a bye too.
Flatter one on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Powerplay 2 signaled. Now a maximum of 4 fielders are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over. Also, there is a bowling change as Adil Rashid is called to roll his arm over.
Finch taps this length ball towards mid on. Calls for the single initially and then sees the fielder charging in. Smith is quick to send him back. No harm done in the end.
Shortish on middle, pulled through square leg for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.
FOUR! Clipped past the fielder! Low full toss, angling in on middle, Smith leans across and flicks it past the diving Rashid at short mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery on middle, tapped through the leg side for a single.
Shuffles across and clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
On a length and outside off, defended with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Good length ball on middle and leg, tucked towards the leg side for nothing.
Pitches it up outside off, driven towards the fielder at mid off.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fullish on off, driven on the up but straight to mid off.
Some lift for Plunkett! He comes in from over the wicket and lands it on a back of a length on middle. Finch hops to tuck it away but gets hit on the gloves. He rings his right hand in agony.
First change of the day. Liam Plunkett comes on to bowl, replacing Woakes.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Tucks this length ball towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
In the avenue of apprehension, AF makes a leave.
Touch short and angling in on middle, Finch gets up on his toes to keep it out.

Peach of a delivery from Wood! Finch had literally no idea about it! Wood hits the deck hard, gets the sumptuous bounce as Finch hangs his bat out in defense. The ball just about whizzes past the outside edge.
Back of a length delivery on middle, punched off the back foot to mid off.

FOUR! Creamed it! Woakes overcooks this one, it's wider outside off. Smith reaches out to that one and drives it along the carpet to beat the dive of the cover fielder. A boundary results. 12 off the over!
Good length delivery outside off, defended towards the point fielder off the back foot.
Gets a fuller delivery on the pads, wristed nealty through the gap at mid-wicket for a couple.

FOUR! Smart shot! Woakes bowls a short one but it's not that threatening enough. Comes at a good height and the Aussie skipper swivels to pull it with aplomb through mid-wicket. No one in the deep and he picks up a boundary to his name.
Fuller and angling in on middle, Smith looks to work it away but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
Sprays one on the pads, deflected down to fine leg for an easy brace.
Stands tall and steers it it towards the point fielder to end the over with a dot ball.

FOUR! Takes him on this time! We saw Finch missing out on the pull shots a couple of times but not this time! Shortish on middle, Aaron Finch fetches it from outside off and dumps it over square leg for a boundary.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Wood pounds in a short ball, it keeps climbing off the deck. Finch looks to pull but is undone by the extra bounce. Good take from Buttler behind the stumps too.
There is some issue near the bowler's landing area. Wood is finding it difficult when he lands his foot. Smith brooms the unwanted stuff...
Angles it on the pads, too easy for the Aussie skipper who flicks it through backward square leg to rotate strike.

What happened there? Wood keeps it full outside off, Smith drives it back down the track past the bowler who slips in his followthrough. This is the second time he has slipped while delivering the ball today.
Gets across and tucks it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Shortish in length on middle and off, defended by staying back.
Drops it on a back of a length on middle and leg, AF hops to tuck but it hits him on the glove as the ball dies down.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Hops back to this back of a length ball and taps it in front of the catching mid-wicket fielder.
Slightly fuller and hurled on off, blocked towards cover.
Wide! Shortish but it's wayward as it is down the leg side, Finch moves inside the line to let it be.

A loud call for an LBW, not given! Wood angles it in from outside off, it zips off the surface and beats the front foot defense of Smith. Hits him on the back pad and they all go up in an appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. Wood has a word with Root but the bowler suggests that the height seems to be the issue. Bang on, Mark. Hawk Eye confirms the same.
Length ball outside off, Finch hits it behind point for one.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Good length delivery on middle, defended back to the bowler.

That took off! Short ball outside off, Finch decides to go after it. Stands tall to fetch it from outside off but this is bowled at 144.6 kph and there is extra bounce which doesn't allow Finch to go after the shot.
Wood angles it in on middle and leg, Aaron Finch tucks it through backward square leg and calls for two immediately. Smith, obviously responds and they take a brace.
Angling in on the pads, clipped down to fine leg for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Cracked it again! Little bit of width offered from Woakes and it's enough for Finch to go after it. He punches it square of the wicket and the two fielders give it a chase but fail to stop it from crossing the rope.
On a length and once again on middle and off, Aaron stays behind the line and shows straight bat.
Back of a length delivery on middle, defended off the back foot comfortably.

Strays one down the leg side, Finch moves inside the line to clip it away but the ball goes off something to Buttler who dives full length to his left to stop it. Fails to do so as the ball goes off his gloves towards square leg. They take a leg bye.
On a length and it's touch short outside off, Smith cuts it towards point. A successful over from Wood.
Steven Smith is the new man in.

OUT! Wood bounces out Warner! England draw first blood. What a delivery! Wood from over the wicket bangs in a short one on middle and off, it keeps climbing on Warner who is in no position to tackle this. He takes his eyes off in an attempt to fend it. The ball takes the gloves and lobs behind. Root from second slip comes a couple of steps ahead and takes a safe catch. David Warner walks back without troubling the scorers much.
Length delivery on middle and off, Warner stays back in defense.

In the air... dropped! That went like a rocket to Morgan! Short and kicking off  the surface, Warner hops again and with an angled bat hits it through the off side. Morgan at cover-point gets a hand to it but fails to hold on. Was a tough chance though. They pick up two.
Brings it back into the southpaw, Warner hops and tucks it towards mid-wicket.

Some bounce straightaway for Wood! Mark from over the wicket hits the deck hard, it kicks off the deck. Warner at first looks to go after it but then realizes it's better to duck under it. Buttler leaps behind to collect it.
Mark Wood to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Little bit of zip off the surface, it's on middle and leg, tapped towards the mid-wicket fielder. Good first over for Australia.
Good length delivery, coming in with the angle, defended back down the track.
Angles it in from around off, Finch covers the sticks and blocks it out.

FOUR! He's flayed it this time! Aaron Finch is in some mood, folks! Woakes drops it short and serves it outside off, Finch stands tall and cracks it through point for a rocketing boundary. Two in the over already.
On a length and just outside off, tapped off the front foot towards point.

FOUR! What a start! Woakes starts off with an overpitched delivery on the stumps, Finch brings his bat down at an angle and punches it down the ground with a full face of the bat past mid on for a boundary to get going.

We are all set to get underway. The players and umpires have made their way out to the middle. The Aussie openers - David Warner and Aaron Finch stride out. England to begin with Chris Woakes first up. Two slips in place for him. Here we go...
Toss - England win the toss and opt to field.

Australia, on the other hand, will be brimming with confidence at the moment. Coming out of an emphatic win in the traditional format, they would be eyeing to keep the domination over the opposition. When it comes to the 50-over format, they aren't the best of the sides due to some inexperience. They have decided to give a look at a few rookies so let's wait and find out who gets a nod. We welcome you for the opening encounter at the MCG. Toss and team update coming up in a bit...

The Ashes is done and dusted but the animosity between the two sides isn't. Australia and England now come together for the 5-match ODI series. It's been a really grueling one for England and one would feel that the change in format, brings about the change in fortunes for them. They have developed reasonably well in limited-overs since then 2015 World Cup and it would be interesting to see how they fare this time around.
